svg.aria-label: Two hosts: a browser on a workstation reaches the trex-web-gui backend through an encrypted SSH tunnel to 127.0.0.1:8765; the backend and the TRex server share the TRex host.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Remote browser: backend and TRex share one host

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The usual lab shape: a headless TRex box in the rack runs both trex-web-gui and TRex, and you tunnel in from your workstation. Everything on the

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: wire is SSH-encrypted, and TRex control stays on the TRex host.

svg.text: Keep TRex's 4501/4500 and the daemon's 8090 behind the host's firewall, so only SSH faces the network. Keep the tunnel's local port equal to the

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: backend's (8765). File-browser paths and .py profiles are on the TRex host. Open in Wireshark needs a display there, so use Download pcap instead.
